description: Fail-fast bring-up flow for reaching full benchmark execution on QEMU with Linux.

artifact_policy.rule: New benchmark and TSVC run artifacts must be placed under workloads/generated/<run-id>/ or a temp directory, never as ad-hoc sibling directories under workloads/.

pr.description: Fastest hard-break lane. Proves ISA/compiler/QEMU prerequisites and the TSVC direct QEMU runtime boundary.

linux.description: Full-OS enablement lane. Adds Linux userspace-entry, rootfs, and libc smoke boundaries before hosted benchmarks.

nightly.description: Promotion lane. Runs PR and Linux prerequisites before full benchmark/SPEC expansion.

stages.why: Stop before toolchain or emulator work if the repository layout or canonical ISA catalog is not coherent.

commands.command: python3 tools/bringup/run_gates.py --profile release-strict --tier pr --gate 'ISA::Golden catalog check' --gate 'ISA::Canonical v0.57 guard'

python3 tools/bringup/check_multi_agent_gates.py --strict-always --mode static --manifest docs/bringup/agent_runs/manifest.yaml --waivers docs/bringup/agent_runs/waivers.yaml --checklists-root docs/bringup/agent_runs/checklists

stages.why: Stop before QEMU or benchmark debugging if the integrated compiler cannot build the active AVS corpus.

commands.command: python3 tools/bringup/run_gates.py --profile release-strict --tier pr --gate 'Compiler::AVS compile suites linx64' --gate 'Compiler::Coverage 100% linx64'
python3 tools/bringup/run_gates.py --profile release-strict --tier pr --gate 'Compiler::AVS compile suites linx32' --gate 'Compiler::Coverage 100% linx32'

stages.why: Stop before benchmark runtime work if QEMU cannot pass strict AVS execution or decode/report coherence.

commands.command: python3 tools/bringup/run_gates.py --profile release-strict --tier pr --gate 'Emulator::QEMU strict system' --gate 'Emulator::QEMU all suites'
python3 tools/bringup/run_gates.py --profile release-strict --tier pr --gate 'Emulator::QEMU opcode meta/id sync audit' --gate 'Emulator::ISA vs QEMU coverage report'

stages.why: Stop before TSVC, Linux, or SPEC if C-CodeGen breadth, QEMU ISA L1 mapping, QEMU translation inventory, and ISA-LLVM-QEMU coverage coherence are not closed.

commands.command: python3 tools/bringup/run_gates.py --profile release-strict --tier nightly --gate 'Compiler::C-CodeGen mnemonic breadth report'
QEMU_ISA_COVERAGE_REQUIRE_FULL=1 python3 tools/bringup/run_gates.py --profile release-strict --tier nightly --gate 'Emulator::ISA vs QEMU coverage report'
QEMU_TRANSLATION_COVERAGE_REQUIRE_FULL=1 python3 tools/bringup/run_gates.py --profile release-strict --tier nightly --gate 'Emulator::AVS QEMU translation coverage report'
ISA_LLVM_QEMU_COVERAGE_REQUIRE_COHERENT=1 python3 tools/bringup/run_gates.py --profile release-strict --tier nightly --gate 'Integration::ISA-LLVM-QEMU coverage coherence report'

stages.why: The current strict PR lane reaches TSVC/QEMU next; run it before Linux rootfs and SPEC so the first benchmark failure is cheap and reproducible.
Stop before hosted benchmarks if the firmwareless Linux/QEMU path cannot enter trivial userspace or boot the rootfs.

commands.command: O="${LINUX_VMLINUX_OUT_DIR:-/tmp/linx-linux-vmlinux-clean-build}" KERNEL="${LINUX_VMLINUX_OUT_DIR:-/tmp/linx-linux-vmlinux-clean-build}/vmlinux" KERNEL_CONFIG="${LINUX_VMLINUX_OUT_DIR:-/tmp/linx-linux-vmlinux-clean-build}/.config" TIMEOUT="${BUSYBOX_ROOTFS_TIMEOUT:-120}" LINX_BUSYBOX_BOOT_RETRY=0 LINX_BUSYBOX_BOOT_BLIND_SEND_AFTER=0 ROOTFS_IMG="$(bash tools/bringup/run_linux_busybox_rootfs_build_clean.sh --linux-root "$PWD/kernel/linux" --out-dir "${LINUX_BUSYBOX_ROOTFS_CLEAN_OUT_DIR:-/tmp/linx-linux-rootfs-clean-out}" --llvm-build "$PWD/compiler/llvm/build-linxisa-clang")" QEMU="${QEMU:-$PWD/emulator/qemu/build-linx/qemu-system-linx64}" QEMU_EXTRA_ARGS='-bios none' SKIP_BUILD=1 python3 kernel/linux/tools/linxisa/busybox_rootfs/boot.py

stages.why: Stop before SPEC and hosted benchmark expansion if the static/shared libc runtime split is not green.

commands.command: python3 avs/qemu/run_musl_smoke.py --mode phase-b --link both --sample all --skip-build --kernel "${LINUX_VMLINUX_OUT_DIR:-/tmp/linx-linux-vmlinux-clean-build}/vmlinux" --qemu "${QEMU:-$PWD/emulator/qemu/build-linx/qemu-system-linx64}" --timeout "${MUSL_TIMEOUT:-90}" && cp avs/qemu/out/musl-smoke/summary.json "$LINX_MUSL_RUNTIME_REPORT" && cat avs/qemu/out/musl-smoke/qemu_*.log > "$LINX_MUSL_RUNTIME_TRANSCRIPT"

stages.why: Run the fast SPECint gate with test/train inputs before broader benchmark expansion, isolating slow VM-stress workloads from cheap regressions.

commands.command: BUILD_MANIFEST="${SPECINT_BUILD_MANIFEST:-$PWD/workloads/generated/specint-fast-gate/build-manifest.json}"; BUILD_ATTESTATION="${SPECINT_BUILD_ATTESTATION:-$PWD/workloads/generated/specint-fast-gate/build-attestation.json}"; BUILD_ATTESTATION_MD="${SPECINT_BUILD_ATTESTATION_MD:-$PWD/workloads/generated/specint-fast-gate/build-attestation.md}"; python3 tools/spec2017/check_build_manifest.py attest --repo-root "$PWD" --manifest "$BUILD_MANIFEST" --out "$BUILD_ATTESTATION" --out-md "$BUILD_ATTESTATION_MD" && python3 tools/spec2017/check_build_manifest.py verify --repo-root "$PWD" --attestation "$BUILD_ATTESTATION"

outputs: build-attestation.json binding the current workspace, toolchain, sysroot, sources, and 12 static Linx ELFs
stage_b_summary.json with heartbeat_running, heartbeat_site_progress, heartbeat_last_bpc, and heartbeat_last_progress
diagnostic_rules: Use LINX_QEMU_HEARTBEAT_INTERVAL on long SPEC train runs to classify live progress vs deadlock by BPC/PC/count churn.

Use LINX_TLB_FILL_TRACE_VA or LINX_QEMU_TLB_FILL_TRACE_VA with count filters when a syscall reports success but the next data access faults; compare legacy_desc/prot/cause before changing QEMU TLB policy.
For late user traps, pair LINX_FAULT_TRACE_PC_LO/HI with LINX_FAULT_TRACE_COUNT_LO/HI before enabling LINX_DEBUG_PC_WATCH_RING.
For late stack or heap producer traces, pair LINX_MEM_TRACE_ADDR/SIZE/ACCESS/ACR with LINX_MEM_TRACE_COUNT_LO/HI so early stack-slot reuse does not consume LINX_MEM_TRACE_LIMIT.

stages.why: Run full benchmark/SPEC expansion only after ISA, compiler, QEMU, Linux userspace, and libc gates are proven in the same lane.

commands.command: BENCH_OUT="${LINX_BENCHMARK_OUT_DIR:-$PWD/workloads/generated/benchmarks}"; BENCHMARK_RESULT="${LINX_BENCHMARK_RESULT:-$PWD/workloads/generated/benchmarks_result.json}"; BENCHMARK_TRANSCRIPT="${LINX_BENCHMARK_TRANSCRIPT:-$PWD/workloads/generated/benchmarks_transcript.txt}"; if [[ -n "${LINX_BENCHMARK_RUN_COMMAND:-}" ]]; then BENCHMARK_RUN_COMMAND="$LINX_BENCHMARK_RUN_COMMAND"; else BENCHMARK_RUN_COMMAND="python3 tools/bringup/run_c_benchmark_matrix.py --kernel ${LINUX_VMLINUX_OUT_DIR:-/tmp/linx-linux-vmlinux-clean-build}/vmlinux --qemu ${QEMU:-$PWD/emulator/qemu/build-linx/qemu-system-linx64} --sysroot ${LINX_SYSROOT:-$PWD/out/libc/musl/install/phase-b} --clang ${CLANG:-$PWD/compiler/llvm/build-linxisa-clang/bin/clang} --timeout ${LINX_BENCHMARK_GUEST_TIMEOUT:-900} --exe {exe}"; fi; LINX_CLANG="${CLANG:-$PWD/compiler/llvm/build-linxisa-clang/bin/clang}" LINX_SYSROOT="${LINX_SYSROOT:-$PWD/out/libc/musl/install/phase-b}" python3 workloads/run_benchmarks.py --cc tools/spec2017/linx_cc.sh --target linx64-unknown-linux-musl --sysroot "${LINX_SYSROOT:-$PWD/out/libc/musl/install/phase-b}" --coremark-iterations "${LINX_COREMARK_ITERATIONS:-15000}" --dhrystone-runs "${LINX_DHRYSTONE_RUNS:-1}" --run-command "$BENCHMARK_RUN_COMMAND" --timeout "${LINX_BENCHMARK_TIMEOUT:-1200}" --out-dir "$BENCH_OUT" --json-out "$BENCHMARK_RESULT" && { for LOG in "$BENCH_OUT"/logs/*.runtime.stdout.txt "$BENCH_OUT"/logs/*.runtime.stderr.txt; do if [[ -f "$LOG" ]]; then cat "$LOG"; fi; done; } > "$BENCHMARK_TRANSCRIPT"

BUILD_MANIFEST="${SPECINT_NIGHTLY_BUILD_MANIFEST:-$PWD/workloads/generated/specint-nightly-test-train/build-manifest.json}"; BUILD_ATTESTATION="${SPECINT_NIGHTLY_BUILD_ATTESTATION:-$PWD/workloads/generated/specint-nightly-test-train/build-attestation.json}"; BUILD_ATTESTATION_MD="${SPECINT_NIGHTLY_BUILD_ATTESTATION_MD:-$PWD/workloads/generated/specint-nightly-test-train/build-attestation.md}"; python3 tools/spec2017/check_build_manifest.py attest --repo-root "$PWD" --manifest "$BUILD_MANIFEST" --out "$BUILD_ATTESTATION" --out-md "$BUILD_ATTESTATION_MD" && python3 tools/spec2017/check_build_manifest.py verify --repo-root "$PWD" --attestation "$BUILD_ATTESTATION"

outputs: benchmarks_result.json with RUN_PASS for both CoreMark and Dhrystone; build-only is rejected
build-attestation.json binding the current workspace, toolchain, sysroot, sources, and 12 static Linx ELFs
stage_b_summary.json with per-row test/train outcomes and heartbeat progress
